We'll need to bring out the big guns!|audio = KorbloxTempleWave-4.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 4 ([[Korblox Temple]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Korblox Warrior''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]. It also appears in [[The Classic Event]] missions as part of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has a high amount of health but it is quite slow. ==Logbook Description== "''Acquiring armor from the Rune Forger tribe, the Korblox Warriors were fighters who yearned for battle. These warriors trained tirelessly, dueling daily, and showed utmost loyalty to The Empire. Although slow, these enemies are formidable opponents that have slaughtered countless Knights of Redcliff.''" ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Warrior''' has blue skin and a neon blue head. It wears a blue helmet with horns, shoulder-pads and chestplate, and grey arm-pads. The front of the chestplate is shaped like a face, with neon blue eyes and teeth, a white nose and eyebrows. It also has grey shoes, black pants and shirt. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Korblox Temple]] is listed instead. *Multiple early-game towers, like the [[Militant]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Medic]] or [[Brawler]] can be useful against this. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]] can kill this quite quickly. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxWarriorSlowStomp.gif|Walking animation (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseKorbloxWarrior.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Hunt- Mega Edition Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Korblox Warrior''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} KorbloxWarriorIconIG.png|'''Korblox Warrior''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Korblox Warrior''' is based on the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/256/Korblox-General Korblox General] package. ==Update History== *'''12 March 2025''' -
